mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCER ( producer_id, user_no, biz_no, biz_name, biz_addr, biz_phone, bank_name, bank_account_no, account_holder, is_verified, verified_at, reject_reason, created_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( #{producerId}, #{userNo}, #{bizNo}, #{bizName}, #{bizAddr}, #{bizPhone}, #{bankName}, #{bankAccountNo}, #{accountHolder}, #{isVerified}, #{verifiedAt}, #{rejectReason}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT producer_id, user_no, biz_no, biz_name, biz_addr, biz_phone, bank_name, bank_account_no, account_holder, is_verified, verified_at, reject_reason, created_date, updated_date FROM PRODUCER WHERE user_no = #{userNo}

SELECT producer_id, user_no, biz_no, biz_name, biz_addr, biz_phone, bank_name, bank_account_no, account_holder, is_verified, verified_at, reject_reason, created_date, updated_date FROM PRODUCER WHERE producer_id = #{producerId}

SELECT producer_id, user_no, biz_no, biz_name, biz_addr, biz_phone, bank_name, bank_account_no, account_holder, is_verified, verified_at, reject_reason, created_date, updated_date FROM PRODUCER WHERE is_verified = 'N' ORDER BY created_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCER SET is_verified = 'Y', verified_at = SYSDATE, reject_reason = NULL, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE producer_id = #{producerId}
UPDATE PRODUCER SET is_verified = 'N', reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE producer_id = #{producerId}
